name: Unbox a Noob 📦✨
desc:
Open A Noob! Simple and unique game with over 100+ Unique Noobs in the game. Get a free GOLDEN CRATE for playing for 5 minutes!!

💥 Smash crates, unlock Noobs
⚔️ Buy better tools, break crates faster
💸 Collect and evolve your Noobs

🤑 Your Noobs keep earning even when you're offline! 💸
